How smart are nonhuman animals?
Animals are incredibly intelligent in many ways. They can even use tools; for example, some crows have mastered the ability to fashion a hook to snag food and place nuts in roadways so that passing vehicles dismantle the shells. Dolphins, who have built-in sonar capabilities and their own language, are so smart they have even been referred to as “nonhuman persons” by researchers.
